FUNCTION CountPaths(rows, cols) IF rows == 1 OR cols == 1 THEN RETURN 1 END IF RETURN CountPaths(rows - 1, cols) + CountPaths(rows, cols - 1) END FUNCTION SET result = CountPaths(3, 3) PRINT result Marks awarded 0 Difficulty - Attempt% 41 Correct% 30 Your time 6 Avg time 72 Explanation: This counts the number of paths from top-left to bottom-right in a grid: CountPaths(3,3) = CountPaths(2,3) + CountPaths(3,2) CountPaths(2,3) = CountPaths(1,3) + CountPaths(2,2) = 1 + [CountPaths(1,2) + CountPaths(2,1)] = 1 + [1 + 1] = 3 CountPaths(3,2) = CountPaths(2,2) + CountPaths(3,1) = [CountPaths(1,2) + CountPaths(2,1)] + 1 = [1 + 1] + 1 = 3 Total = 3 + 3 = 6

FUNCTION DigitalRoot(num) IF num < 10 THEN RETURN num END IF SET sum = 0 WHILE num > 0 sum = sum + (num MOD 10) num = num / 10 END WHILE RETURN DigitalRoot(sum) END FUNCTION SET result = DigitalRoot(9875) PRINT result Marks awarded 0 Difficulty - Attempt% 37 Correct% 17 Your time 6 Avg time 76 Explanation: Digital root calculation: 9875: 9+8+7+5 = 29 29: 2+9 = 11 11: 1+1 = 2 The digital root of 9875 is 2.
